title: The Night in Bekoji
logline: In 1950 E.C. in Bekoji, a young man travelling to see another woman stops for the night at a hospitable home—and meets the woman he chooses to spend his life with.
audience: My family (parents, aunts, uncles, and cousins) watching on their phones in the family group chat.
intent: They feel warmth, pride, and nostalgia remembering how their parents' and grandparents' story began.

style.block: Warm painterly documentary illustration, 1950s Ethiopian highland atmosphere, soft firelight and misty dawn, muted earth palette of ochre, umber, and deep highland green, gentle film grain, subject centred in the frame, no text or lettering
style.negative: text, letters, watermark, extra fingers, deformed hands, blurry face, modern clothing, cars, electricity poles
style.reference_prompt: Style frame: a quiet 1950s Ethiopian highland home in Bekoji at dusk, mud-and-wood walls, warm hearth firelight glowing inside, misty eucalyptus hills outside, painterly documentary illustration

characters.description: A young Ethiopian man in his mid-twenties in 1950s highland attire, warm brown skin, short curly black hair, gentle determined eyes, wearing a white cotton shamma wrapped over a simple tunic and a dark woollen cloak against the cold night

A young Ethiopian woman in her early twenties in 1950s highland attire, warm brown skin, braided hair partially covered by a white cotton netela shawl with a subtle woven tibeb border over a traditional white habesha kemis dress, calm graceful smile

voice.style: warm, unhurried, respectful, like a family member telling a cherished story by the fire

lines: የበቆጂው ምሽት · The Night in Bekoji (1950 E.C.)
Made with AI · በሰው ሰራሽ አስተውሎት የተሰራ

shots.reason: Establishing shot: sets the year (1950 E.C.) and the cold highland town of Bekoji at dusk.
shots.image_prompt: A quiet 1950s Ethiopian highland town of Bekoji at dusk, round thatched and mud-walled homes nestled among tall eucalyptus trees, cold blue mist drifting across rolling hills, warm golden light in a distant window
shots.motion_prompt: Mist drifts slowly through the eucalyptus trees, distant light flickers softly, camera pushes in very slowly.
shots.narration: በ1950 ዓመተ ምሕረት፣ በቀዝቃዛው የበቆጂ ከተማ ዳርቻ ምሽቱ ገብቶ ነበር።
shots.subtitle: In 1950 E.C., night had fallen on the cold outskirts of Bekoji.

shots.reason: Shows the grandfather and his friend on the road to visit another girl, setting up the unexpected turn.
shots.image_prompt: The grandfather and his male friend walking together along a quiet dirt highland path at twilight, wrapped in woollen cloaks against the cold wind, open Bekoji hills behind them
shots.motion_prompt: The two travellers walk slowly forward along the path, their cloaks swaying gently in the evening breeze, camera tracks slowly.
shots.narration: አያቴ እና ጓደኛው ሌላ ሴት ልጅ ሊያዩ ረጅም መንገድ ተጉዘው ነበር።
shots.subtitle: My grandfather and his friend had walked a long way to meet another girl.

shots.reason: Night forces them to stop for shelter, bringing them to the grandmother's home.
shots.image_prompt: Under a deep indigo starry highland sky, the grandfather stands outside a traditional mud-walled home with warm amber firelight glowing through an open wooden doorway
shots.motion_prompt: Warm firelight flickers from the doorway onto the night mist, camera pushes in gently.
shots.narration: ነገር ግን መሽቶ ስለነበር፣ በመንገዳቸው ባገኙት ቤት ለማደር ተጠጉ።
shots.subtitle: But night grew late, so they stopped at a house along the road to ask for shelter.

shots.reason: Establishes the warmth and traditional Ethiopian hospitality inside the home.
shots.image_prompt: Inside a warm hearth-lit Ethiopian home, the grandmother pours warm coffee from a black clay jebena into small cups for guests seated on low wooden stools, soft smoke rising in golden firelight
shots.motion_prompt: She pours gently into the cup as hearth firelight dances on the walls, steam rises softly, camera stays still.
shots.narration: እዚያም ቤት ውስጥ በእንግዳ ተቀባይነት የሞቀ እራትና ፈገግታ ጠበቃቸው።
shots.subtitle: Inside, warm hospitality, dinner, and a gentle welcome awaited them.

shots.reason: The turning point: grandfather sees the grandmother for the first time across the firelight.
shots.image_prompt: Close-up of the grandfather seated by the hearth, warm orange firelight illuminating his face as he looks up with quiet wonder and attention
shots.motion_prompt: Firelight flickers softly across his face as his expression softens into a quiet smile, camera stays still.
shots.narration: በእሳቱ ብርሃን ውስጥ አያቴ የቤቱን ልጅ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ አያት።
shots.subtitle: In the glow of the hearth, my grandfather saw the daughter of the house for the first time.

shots.reason: Focuses on her calm grace and warmth, showing emotionally why he forgot his original plan.
shots.image_prompt: Close-up portrait of the grandmother smiling modestly in warm hearth light, her white cotton netela draped gracefully over her shoulders
shots.motion_prompt: Warm firelight glows gently on her face as she smiles softly, camera pushes in very slowly.
shots.narration: ትህትናዋና የዓይኗ ብርሃን የሌሊቱን ቅዝቃዜ በአንዴ አስረሳው።
shots.subtitle: Her grace and the warmth in her eyes made him forget the cold night at once.

shots.reason: Dawn breaks in Bekoji; visually marks his decision to choose her instead of continuing.
shots.image_prompt: At golden misty dawn outside the home in Bekoji, the grandfather stands wrapped in his shamma, looking back warmly toward the doorway as morning sun breaks over the hills
shots.motion_prompt: Morning mist drifts behind him as he turns slightly and smiles with quiet resolve, camera stays still.
shots.narration: ንጋት ሲቀድ፣ አያቴ ሌላዋን ትቶ እሷን ለመምረጥ ልቡ ቆረጠ።
shots.subtitle: By dawn, his heart was made up—he left the other journey behind and chose her.

shots.reason: Time compression: shows them walking together across the sunlit Bekoji hills.
shots.image_prompt: Wide shot of the grandfather and grandmother walking side by side along a sunlit green ridge in Bekoji, tall eucalyptus trees and rolling highlands bathed in warm morning gold
shots.motion_prompt: Sunlight shimmers across the green hills, camera pans slowly to the right.
shots.narration: ያ የአንድ ምሽት እንግድነት ለዘላለም የማይፈታ የፍቅር ኪዳን ሆነ።
shots.subtitle: That single night of shelter became a lifelong bond of love.

shots.reason: Closing motif: two coffee cups steaming beside a window overlooking Bekoji—legacy and family warmth.
shots.image_prompt: Two small white coffee cups (sini) steaming beside a black clay jebena on a wooden table by an open window overlooking misty green Bekoji hills in warm morning light
shots.motion_prompt: Gentle steam rises from the two cups in the morning light, camera pulls back slowly.
shots.narration: የቤተሰባችን ታሪክ የተጀመረው በዚያች የበቆጂ ምሽት ነበር።
shots.subtitle: Our family's story began on that one night in Bekoji.
